text.p: Lithuanian fridge maker Snaige said on Tuesday that its loss in the first quarter of 1997 was 4.2 million litas versus a loss of 3.5 million litas in the first quarter of last year.
Sales were also lower at 22 million litas in the first quarter versus 24 million litas in the same period last year, company director general Antanas Andriulionis, told Reuters.
He said the reason for the sales fall was that 43 percent of the sales were in German marks and this year the mark fell and the litas was stable at four to one dollar.
"Nearly all of our sales in marks brought the losses," he said.
He added that the company plans to increase sales by 30 percent in the second quarter of the year and that usually the company make up for the losses in the third quarter.
It exports 90 percent of its products.
